platform.cpu: 6-core CPU with 2 performance and 4 efficiency cores

charging.claim: Fast-charge capable: Up to 50% charge in 30 minutes with 20W adapter or higher (available separately) paired with USB-C charging cable, or 30W adapter or higher paired with MagSafe

rear_detail: 48MP Fusion Main: 26mm, ƒ/1.6 aperture, sensor-shift optical image stabilisation, 100% Focus Pixels, support for super-high-resolution photos (24MP and 48MP)
Also enables 12MP optical-quality 2x Telephoto: 52mm, ƒ/1.6 aperture, sensor-shift optical image stabilisation, 100% Focus Pixels

connectivity.positioning: Precision dual-frequency GPS (GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, QZSS, BeiDou and NavIC); Digital compass; Wi-Fi; Mobile data
connectivity.sim: Dual eSIM (two active eSIMs; stores eight or more eSIMs); iPhone Air uses advanced eSIM technology for more convenience and security (not compatible with physical SIM cards).

software.policy_note: Apple publishes no fixed upgrade commitment. Recent iPhones have received about six years of major iOS releases plus further security fixes, so the figures here are platform estimates.

specs.sensors: Face ID, Barometer, High dynamic range gyro, High-g accelerometer, Proximity sensor, Dual ambient light sensors

default.note: Read from Apple Malaysia's specification page on 2026-09-18. Values were extracted automatically and reviewed; anything the page does not state is left out.

announced.note: Date of the first Malaysian launch report found (SoyaCincau). The global announcement can be earlier.

specs.display.ppi.note: Calculated from resolution and screen size.

specs.camera.zoom_optical_x.note: One rear camera; the "2x Telephoto" is a crop of the main camera, not an optical zoom.

specs.memory.ram_gb.note: Apple does not list RAM; MacRumors found it in Apple's Xcode developer tool.

specs.battery.capacity_mah.note: Apple states capacity only on its EU energy labels (iPhone Air is eSIM-only everywhere), as reported by MacRumors.

specs.charging.wired_w.note: Apple gives a time-based claim and an adapter rating, not the phone's maximum input. The adapter rating is used as an estimate.

specs.software.os_updates_years.note: Apple publishes no fixed upgrade commitment; estimate from the support recent iPhones have received.

specs.software.security_updates_years.note: Apple publishes no fixed upgrade commitment; estimate from the support recent iPhones have received.
